nei_applicability.reason: Identity profiles constrain q/proof reuse, but method emergence is primarily a layer/closure question.

leads.name: solver-consumer labels are not semantic topology
leads.statement: Removing consumed_by solver labels leaves the operational/proof claim topology connected; solver names act primarily as consumer/provenance metadata at this layer.
leads.falsifier: A load-bearing semantic path required solely a solver-consumer edge.

leads.name: ranked alternating ordinary WDL recurrence
leads.statement: Exact behavior state + legal transition + terminal boundary + alternating player quantification + strictly increasing occupied-cell rank induces a unique exact WDL value recurrence by backward induction.
leads.scope_note: Standard-7x6 q is a newer deductive candidate, not yet frozen authority.

leads.name: state-evolution orientation versus value-dependency orientation
leads.statement: The legal state edge points q_r->q_(r+1), while exact value dependency points V(q_(r+1))->V(q_r). IsoMax forward child discovery and BSFP backward predecessor propagation operate on different layers of this same relation.
leads.falsifier: Show different exact WDL dependency semantics between the active solvers rather than different discovery/evaluation schedules.

leads.name: solver differentiation is primarily evaluation/materialization policy
leads.statement: IsoMax is demand-driven evaluation of unresolved dependencies with theorem shortcuts; BSFP is supply-driven symbolic predecessor/value-family evaluation. Both implement the same ordinary WDL relation when exact.
leads.residual: Implementation forms and stronger proof-context handling remain solver-specific.

leads.name: antichain and clause frontiers are representation layer
leads.statement: Ownership antichains, line-product antichains, terminal-subtraction frontiers and support-local clause dictionaries are exact/qualified representations of semantic families and transforms, not separate game-value semantics.

leads.name: guarded structural calculus is shortcut proof topology
leads.statement: NDC/certificates can be interpreted as sound shortcut edges deriving the same exact consequences that ordinary transition dependencies would establish, subject to explicit guards.
leads.residual: Complete compact guarded-obligation closure remains unresolved.

leads.name: SUT as meeting evaluation fronts over one dependency relation
leads.statement: A future SUT may be naturally modeled as root-demand and terminal-supply evaluation fronts sharing exact value/proof facts over one Connect4 dependency topology, rather than as a semantic weld between two different games.
guards: ordinary gameplay identity must be exact
parent solver private representations are not semantic authority
leads.falsifier: A required cross-solver exact fact cannot be expressed on shared Connect4 value/proof topology without importing private solver semantics.

optimization_leads: compile forward transition and backward predecessor views from one exact cofactor relation
collapse distinctions before materialization when the next exact projection erases them
separate state discovery from value propagation
use rank induction for ordinary progression and fixed-point iteration only for genuine closure cycles
compile qualified certificates as shortcut proof edges
publish exact value/proof facts by semantic identity profile rather than private representation
